name: menubar-38
description: Source control menubar with a branch switcher radio, pull and push actions and a current-branch indicator.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { Archive as ArchiveIcon, ArrowDownToLine as ArrowDownToLineIcon, ArrowUpFromLine as ArrowUpFromLineIcon, GitBranch as GitBranchIcon, RefreshCw as RefreshCwIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Menubar, MenubarContent, MenubarGroup, MenubarItem, MenubarLabel, MenubarMenu, MenubarRadioGroup, MenubarRadioItem, MenubarSeparator, MenubarShortcut, MenubarTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/menubar" const branches = ["main", "feat/billing-portal", "fix/rate-limit", "chore/deps"] export default function GitBranchMenubar() { const [branch, setBranch] = React.useState("feat/billing-portal") return ( Repository Pull{" "} ⇧⌘P Push ⌘P Fetch origin Stash changes Branch Switch to {branches.map((b) => ( {b} ))} New branch... ⇧⌘N Merge into main {branch} ) }
